nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address recorded by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol, set to LUJZ in the LuJiaZuiToken constructor.
ERC20 token name, set in the LuJiaZuiToken constructor.
Token decimals, set to 8 in the constructor.
Total token supply assigned to the deployer in the constructor; read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account to token balance; mutated in the constructor, balanceOf airdrop branch, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve and approveAndCall and read/decremented by transferFrom.
Total airdrop budget; compared against currentTotalSupply inside balanceOf.
Amount of tokens already airdropped; incremented without bounds checking inside balanceOf.
Per-account airdrop amount (9999) credited inside balanceOf.
Mapping marking accounts that already received the airdrop.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending new owner address.
Transfers ownership when msg.sender equals newOwner and resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor that initializes metadata, assigns the whole supply and seeds airdrop parameters.
View function returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Declared view/constant but mutates state: performs a free airdrop for any untouched caller-specified address before returning the balance.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender to tokens without checking the current value.
Spends the caller allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets an allowance and then performs an external call into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts so no ETH can be received.
onlyOwner function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
Checked addition helper with overflow requirement.
Checked subtraction helper with underflow requirement.
Checked multiplication helper with overflow requirement.
Checked division helper rejecting division by zero.
Caller identity used for balances, allowances, ownership assignment and ownership checks.
Unbounded unchecked airdrop: balanceOf sets touched[_owner], adds airdropNum to currentTotalSupply and credits balances[_owner] with free tokens in a view function.
External call into the user-supplied spender contract via ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval before state settles, opening reentrancy.
External call into an arbitrary attacker-controlled token contract via ERC20Interface.transfer inside an onlyOwner function.
Candidate owner address passed to transferOwnership.
Attacker-controlled address whose balance is queried and whose airdrop branch is triggered.
Recipient address of transfer.
Amount of tokens passed to transfer.
Spender address granted an allowance.
Allowance amount passed to approve.
Source account of transferFrom.
Destination account of transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved by transferFrom.
Token owner queried by allowance.
Spender queried by allowance.
Spender contract that receives the approval callback.
Allowance amount set by approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary external token contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
Amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
Local return value of balanceOf reflecting the airdrop-inflated balance.
Local return value of allowance.

edges.reason: transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller identity flows into the state update.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], consuming the caller identity.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to receiveApproval.
The Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Any caller sending plain ETH hits the payable fallback, which immediately reverts.
balanceOf uses the caller-supplied _owner to index touched and balances.
balanceOf returns the resulting balance value.
balanceOf unconditionally performs the airdrop state mutation and unchecked arithmetic.
airdropNum (9999) is added to balances and to currentTotalSupply without any bound check.
currentTotalSupply is compared with totalADSupply and then incremented without overflow protection.
totalADSupply caps the airdrop loop condition inside balanceOf.
The airdrop branch writes currentTotalSupply += airdropNum with no overflow guard.
The airdrop branch credits arbitrary balances[_owner] with free tokens.
The airdrop branch marks touched[_owner] = true to prevent repeat minting.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner] before and after the airdrop.
transfer credits balances[to] with the recipient parameter.
transfer uses the tokens parameter to debit and credit balances.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub for underflow protection.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd for overflow protection.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping.
approve stores the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the from parameter.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the to parameter.
transferFrom spends the tokens parameter from both balance and allowance.
transferFrom uses safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance uses tokenOwner as the first mapping key.
allowance uses spender as the second mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the stored remaining amount.
approveAndCall uses the user-supplied spender contract as the callback target.
approveAndCall sets the allowance to the tokens parameter.
approveAndCall forwards arbitrary data to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary contract, exposing the external-call unsafe operation.
transferAnyERC20Token casts the attacker-supplied tokenAddress to ERC20Interface.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the tokens parameter to the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an unchecked external call on an untrusted contract.
transferAnyERC20Token directs the swept tokens to the owner address.
transferOwnership stores the _newOwner parameter.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier reads owner to gate transferOwnership.
The Owned constructor initializes the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
acceptOwnership checks that msg.sender equals the stored newOwner.
The constructor sets the token symbol.
The constructor sets the token name.
The constructor sets the decimals value.
The constructor assigns _totalSupply.
The constructor mints the whole supply to the deployer address in balances.
The constructor initializes totalADSupply.
The constructor initializes currentTotalSupply to zero.
The constructor initializes airdropNum.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts the burned balance held at address(0).
The receiveApproval external call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions before state settles.
The external ERC20 transfer call can re-enter transferAnyERC20Token or the token contract itself.

Forwarded payload parameter consumed directly by the external receiveApproval call.
